eventAndTimeCapacity.preflight: At actual scheduled active-resolution, legacy resolution, or due-recovery daily boundaries, an isolated canonical boundary preview protects simulate. Public time-advancing actions that reach such a boundary first execute their complete internal action on an isolated full-state clone, including pre-simulation mutations and trailing events; final event/NPC/director counters are checked before the live action runs once. Normal non-boundary actions do not clone. Clone RNG/events are isolated.
eventAndTimeCapacity.tradeoff: Full-state action clones include bounded history up to 20,000 events; camp-raid combat also runs its existing E clone preview during an F-boundary preview. Measure this combined cost during I/J; no guessed fast path was added.
eventAndTimeCapacity.safeWorldTimeGuard: The action preflight rejects non-finite/negative durations and unsafe resulting worldTime before checking whether a crisis boundary is present; this O(1) check leaves normal actions clone-free.

recovery.behavior: At the due boundary, grant one adult canonical immigration NPC only if living population remains zero and the Goblin Chief remains alive; otherwise persist cancellation.
